name: Philip Morris International
note: Official Partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to pmi.com/markets/italy, stands under 'Official Partners' with the line 'Phillip Morris International' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Left unrated for a maintainer, like zyn: the owner is sourced (pmi-shareholders: NYSE-listed; the holders above 5% are Vanguard, Capital World Investors, Capital International Investors and BlackRock), but the company test isn't settled. Human Rights Watch's report 'Hellish Work' (2010-07-14, https://www.hrw.org/report/2010/07/14/hellish-work/exploitation-migrant-tobacco-workers-kazakhstan) documented, from research in 2009, the exploitation of migrant workers, including child labour, on Kazakh farms that supplied tobacco to Philip Morris Kazakhstan, a PMI subsidiary. Its later reports on hazardous child labour in tobacco farming name PMI among the buyers: in the United States ('Tobacco's Hidden Children', 2014-05-14, https://www.hrw.org/report/2014/05/14/tobaccos-hidden-children/hazardous-child-labor-united-states-tobacco-farming) and in Indonesia through its subsidiary Sampoerna ('The Harvest is in My Blood', 2016-05-25, https://www.hrw.org/report/2016/05/25/harvest-my-blood/hazardous-child-labor-tobacco-farming-indonesia). In the Zimbabwe report (2018) PMI told Human Rights Watch it doesn't buy tobacco there. No record claim is written yet.
